parameters.query:
MERGE `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.user_preferences` T
USING (SELECT '{{ $json.userId }}' as userId) S
ON T.userId = S.userId
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE SET 
    priceRange = COALESCE({{ $json.priceRange }}, T.priceRange),
    preferredBedrooms = COALESCE({{ $json.preferredBedrooms }}, T.preferredBedrooms),
    preferredLocations = ARRAY_CONCAT(T.preferredLocations, {{ JSON.stringify($json.preferredLocations) }}),
    searchCount = T.searchCount + 1,
    lastUpdated = '{{ $json.lastUpdated }}'
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (userId, priceRange, preferredBedrooms, preferredLocations, preferredDevelopers, searchCount, lastUpdated)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.userId }}', {{ $json.priceRange }}, {{ $json.preferredBedrooms }}, {{ JSON.stringify($json.preferredLocations) }}, {{ JSON.stringify($json.preferredDevelopers) }}, 1, '{{ $json.lastUpdated }}')

WITH user_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    userId,
    priceRange,
    preferredBedrooms,
    preferredLocations,
    searchCount
  FROM `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.user_preferences`
  WHERE lastUpdated >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
),
recommendations AS (
  SELECT 
    us.userId,
    p.*,
    -- Scoring algorithm
    (
      CASE WHEN p.price <= us.priceRange THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN p.bedrooms = us.preferredBedrooms THEN 15 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN p.location IN UNNEST(us.preferredLocations) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN p.is_new THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
    ) as recommendation_score
  FROM user_stats us
  CROSS JOIN `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.properties` p
  WHERE p.status = 'available'
)
SELECT *
FROM recommendations
WHERE recommendation_score > 20
ORDER BY userId, recommendation_score DESC
